_about: Therapeutic-class alternatives for non-formulary pharmacy messages. Edit freely. Tiers are approximate adult/adolescent dose tiers (GINA/NAEPP style) or potency classes; always confirm against the current plan formulary. Not a substitute for clinical judgment.
